## Card requirements

- One question per card.
- Short answer checked against an explicit source anchor.
- Do not use facts outside the supplied source as if they were in it.
- Missing answer goes into a gap log, not an invented back.
- Conflicting or ambiguous passages require review before studying.
- Exclude room changes and other administrative notes unless intentionally needed.

## Review worksheet

| Question | Draft answer | Source anchor | Clear / partial / gap | Checked by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [one question] | [short answer] | [line or time] | [status] | [reviewer] |

## Import shape

For a two-field Basic note, export UTF-8 tab-separated Front and Back, no header.
Include the source anchor in the back text. Preview the field mapping before import.
Do not place literal tabs or newlines inside these individual fields.
